# `FindStar`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Star-detection worker notification: start, complete with the detected stars, or fail.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, FindStarFunc @0x269780 (stop-code substitution @0x269e78-0x269ea0, fail notify @0x269bdc) (64-bit build); NotifyState @0xb0430, NotifyValueState @0xadc90 |

State/value family (S + V), not F: the star-detection worker sends start, then complete with result, or fail. The state helper adds error and code only when the supplied code is > 0 (unlike F); there is no lapse_ms or route. The complete event's result is the same object the getter caches (get_find_star_result), embedded as JSON, not a string. stop_find_star adds no event of its own, but after a stop a run that had not completed ends with fail, code 253 when the stop coincided with a capture abort and 514 otherwise; a run that had already completed sends complete. Channel I (TCP 4700). Delivery: ordinary broadcast to every retained socket of the emitting server (master, guest and never-verified sockets alike); no cadence, delivery or ordering guarantee relative to RPC replies or other events. APK 3.3.2 defines the name as a constant only.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"FindStar"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Literal states of the worker. One of: `start`, `complete`, `fail`. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if supplied code > 0 | - | Message for code. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if supplied code > 0 | - | Supplied error code (> 0). After stop_find_star, 253 (stop during a capture abort) or 514 (interrupt). [READ] |
| `result` | object | if state is complete | - | Detected stars; same object as the get_find_star_result cache. [READ] |
| `result.image_id` | integer | yes | - | Image id, from the unsigned 16-bit image header id. Range: >= 0, <= 65535. [READ] |
| `result.stars` | array<object> | yes | - | Detected stars; may be empty. [READ] |
| `result.stars[].pixelx` | number | yes | - | X position. INFERRED image pixels; origin and orientation unresolved. [READ] |
| `result.stars[].pixely` | number | yes | - | Y position. INFERRED image pixels; origin and orientation unresolved. [READ] |
| `result.stars[].radius` | number | yes | - | Star radius. INFERRED pixels. [READ] |
| `result.stars[].hfd` | number | yes | - | Half-flux diameter. INFERRED pixels; convention unresolved. [READ] |
| `result.pixelscale_arcsec` | number | if omitted if the pixel-scale query fails | - | Plate scale, INFERRED arcseconds per pixel. Omitted when the pixel-scale query fails. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, complete - Detection finished (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"FindStar","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","result":{"image_id":41,"stars":[{"pixelx":512.4,"pixely":300.8,"radius":3.2,"hfd":2.9}],"pixelscale_arcsec":2.4}}
```

Event, stopped - Run interrupted by stop_find_star (READ shape and code):

```json
{"Event":"FindStar","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"fail","error":"interrupt","code":514}
```

Event, start - Worker started (READ shape):

```json
{"Event":"FindStar","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"start"}
```
